adminNav.title: TX administration.

adminOnboarding.agreementHint: Locale arrays must have matching IDs, icons, and order. Publishing a change requires renewed consent.

adminBackups.noJobsHint: Scheduled work and retries will appear here.
adminBackups.deleteJobDescription: Pending, completed, and failed work may be removed. A currently processing job remains protected.
